Posting this from a different account to avoid unnecessary backlash or issues for sharing my honest experience.
One of the worst coaching experiences I have ever had. The institute seems completely uninterested in the issue education of its students, especially for NEET. Any complaints, concerns, or feedback raised by students were either ignored or brushed aside.
The teaching quality is mediocre at best. Most teachers lack the ability to explain concepts properly, and some seem completely unmotivated to teach. What is even more disappointing is the attitude of the management. There is little to no accountability, and students are expected to simply accept whatever problems arise. The institute cares more about marketing and content creation than actually helping students learn.

I would strongly advise students and parents to think twice before enrolling here. There are far better options available that genuinely value education and student development.
